meeting.title: Investor update call
meeting.headline: ANZ pricing moved to September due to demand
meeting.summary: The ANZ pricing has been moved to September due to changes in demand from enterprise prospects who want usage-based tiers instead of per seat pricing. The agent is rebuilding the tiers and will share the prospecting table and updated tier model by the end of the month.

utterances.speaker: Rachita
utterances.text: Thanks for making time. Headline is that ANZ pricing moved to September, and I want to walk you through why that is the right call.

utterances.speaker: Investor
utterances.text: September is fine if the reason is demand shaped. Is it?

utterances.speaker: Rachita
utterances.text: Yes. Enterprise prospects want usage based tiers instead of per seat pricing, so we are rebuilding the tiers rather than shipping the wrong model.

utterances.speaker: Investor
utterances.text: Send me the prospecting table and the updated tier model when they are ready. And keep an eye on that renewal risk you mentioned last time.

utterances.speaker: Rachita
utterances.text: Will do. The prospecting table of two hundred fifty companies is in progress, I will share both by end of month.
